title: issue48164/fix48163 S3 concurrent uploader overwrites root error

payload.user_symptom: S3 concurrent uploader can surface io: read/write on closed pipe instead of the real upload failure
payload.issue_signal: issue 48164 minimal reproduce shows io: read/write on closed pipe; fix test asserts Close contains mock upload error
payload.expected_next_step: execute the upstream TestMultiUploadErrorNotOverwritten oracle on intro/fix revisions, adding the fix test to the vulnerable revision if needed

provenance.source: issue 48164 metadata plus intro/fix source diff

name: External storage S3 concurrent writer pipeline

state_model: s3ObjectWriter owns an io.PipeWriter, a background upload goroutine, and a stored err
bufferedWriter uploads chunks through ExternalFileWriter.Write and returns ExternalFileWriter.Close
side_effects: write buffered data into pipe writer
background goroutine reads from pipe reader and calls UploadWithContext/Upload
foreground Close closes pipe writer and waits for goroutine
background path may close pipe reader with or without a root error
harness_capabilities: gomock S3 API can force CreateMultipartUploadWithContext or upload setup to return a chosen error
data larger than 5MiB triggers the multipart/concurrent path
final Write/Close error string or chain can be checked for injected root identity
same unit-level oracle can replay intro/fix without a live S3 service

provenance.source: intro commit 5309c2ff and fix b99d1c4f source scan

name: S3 concurrent upload must preserve root upload error identity

payload.p_check: WriterOption.Concurrency > 1 routes S3 Create through s3manager.Uploader with an io.Pipe; the background goroutine receives an upload error while the foreground writer/closer observes pipe state.
payload.q_claim: the final user-visible Write/Close error must preserve the root upload failure identity and context, not replace it with a secondary pipe close/read/write error

boundary.before: UploadWithContext/Upload returns a chosen root error in the background goroutine
boundary.after: ExternalFileWriter.Write or Close returns to the caller

source_anchors: intro 5309c2ff br/pkg/storage/storage.go:83-111 defines WriterOption and Create(ctx,path,option)
intro 5309c2ff br/pkg/storage/s3.go:938-971 selects concurrent upload and wires io.Pipe to s3manager.Uploader
intro 5309c2ff br/pkg/storage/s3.go:960-965 calls UploadWithContext, then rd.Close, then stores s3Writer.err
intro 5309c2ff br/pkg/storage/s3.go:927-934 closes pipe writer and waits before returning s3Writer.err
fix b99d1c4f br/pkg/storage/s3.go:1046-1052 uses rd.CloseWithError(err) instead of rd.Close after upload failure
fix b99d1c4f br/pkg/storage/s3_test.go:487-502 asserts the final Close error contains the injected mock upload error
consumers: Dumpling/export paths once WriterOption concurrency is plumbed
payload.consequence: operator sees a generic closed-pipe error and loses the cloud/upload root cause; retry or diagnosis may follow the wrong failure path
payload.experiment_need: force upload root error in the concurrent path, write enough data to trigger multipart streaming, then assert the final Close result contains the injected root error

name: Inject S3 multipart upload root error before pipe close

payload.source_anchor: br/pkg/storage/s3.go concurrent Create branch calls s3manager.UploadWithContext in a background goroutine while foreground writes through io.Pipe

trigger_condition.operation: ExternalStorage.Create(ctx, name, &WriterOption{Concurrency: 2}) followed by Write(data > 5MiB) and Close
trigger_condition.failure: CreateMultipartUploadWithContext or upload setup returns a chosen root error such as mock error

observe: final w.Close(ctx) error contains the injected root error
final error does not collapse to io: read/write on closed pipe
non-concurrent or no-error control still succeeds
payload.red_signature: vulnerable revision returns or exposes pipe close/read/write error instead of the injected upload root error
payload.green_signature: fixed revision returns an error containing the injected root error via CloseWithError propagation
payload.cleanup: no live S3 service needed; reset gomock expectations per test

provenance.source: fix PR 48163 unit test and s3.go diff

rationale: the bug is a root upload error being replaced by a secondary pipe close error
injecting a known upload error and checking the final Close error is the strongest oracle
the S3 writer is a two-goroutine producer/uploader pipeline
the root upload failure races with pipe close/drain and final error observation
the fault must land in the background upload path before foreground final error is read
